gloss: mixed rice, seasoned rice cooked with ingredients

definitions.explanation: Rice cooked together with various ingredients like vegetables, meat, or seafood, seasoned with soy sauce and dashi.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}は{栗|くり}の{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}が{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Chestnut mixed rice is delicious in autumn.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}を{炊飯器|すいはんき}で{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made mixed rice in the rice cooker.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}ごぼうの{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like chicken and burdock root mixed rice.

notes:
POPULAR VARIETIES:
- {栗|くり}ご{飯|はん}: chestnut rice (autumn seasonal)
- {松茸|まつたけ}ご{飯|はん}: matsutake mushroom rice
- {鯛|たい}めし: sea bream rice
- {筍|たけのこ}ご{飯|はん}: bamboo shoot rice (spring seasonal)

ALSO CALLED:
- {混|ま}ぜご{飯|はん}: mixed rice (sometimes used interchangeably, though technically 混ぜご飯 is mixed after cooking)
